title: 新游速递：Titanium Court、No Man's Sky、Sifu、Vampire Crawlers 等
content:
New game digest: Titanium Court, No Man’s Sky, Sifu, Vampire Crawlers and many more – Mobilegamer.biz

Titanium Court (Fellow Traveller)
Fellow Traveller’s Titanium Court, a match 3 and tower defence game, comes to iOS, Android, PS5, Switch and Switch 2 on October 29 after debuting on PC in April. Created by AP Thomson (Consume Me, Fortune-499), it won the Seumas McNally Grand Prize and the Excellence in Design award at this year’s IGF Awards.
Titanium Court will be available for $6.99 globally.
No Man’s Sky (Hello Games)
Hello Games’ space exploration and survival game No Man’s Sky makes its mobile debut on iPhone and iPad on October 28, as part of Apple’s Indie Games Week. It is free to try, with a $19.99 purchase to unlock the full game. The mobile version includes every major content expansion to date, including the latest Cosmos update.
Sifu (Sloclap)
Sloclap’s kung fu brawler Sifu launched on iOS and Android on October 12, after releasing on PC and consoles. Apple says the iPhone and iPad version has custom touch controls, a reworked camera and full controller support.
Vampire Crawlers (Poncle)
Poncle, the studio behind Vampire Survivors, launched Vampire Crawlers, a gothic card battler with deck building, on iOS and Android on October 12. Listed as part of Apple’s Indie Games Week, the premium mobile game is already out on PC and consoles.
9 Kings (Playdigious)
Playdigious launched roguelike kingdom builder 9 Kings, from Hooded Horse and Sad Socket, on iOS and Android on October 12. It is free to try, with a $9.99 purchase to unlock the full game, and supports 29 languages.
The game sold over 1m copies in early access on PC. On Android, a Google Play Games account carries progress across to PC.
Little Kitty, Big City (Double Dagger Studio)
Double Dagger Studio’s open world adventure Little Kitty, Big City is available now on iPhone and iPad, also as part of Apple’s Indie Games Week. It launched on Xbox, Switch and PC in 2024 and puts players in the paws of a kitten trying to find their way home through a colourful city.
Gundam Blitz Order (Bandai Namco)
Bandai Namco has announced Gundam Blitz Order, an idle game for iOS and Android set in the Gundam universe where players build teams of mobile suits, warships and armours, with auto battle, boss fights and PvP modes. A network test is slated for selected regions from November 18 to 24, with 500 places per region. Applications open until October 26. There is no release date yet.
Totopia World (Nuverse)
Nuverse, the games arm of Bytedance, appears to be soft launching Totopia World, a free party platformer, on Android in Germany. Appmagic first detected it on October 13.
Totopia is also planned for iOS, PC, PS5 and Xbox Series, with a full launch targeted for the second quarter of 2027.
Replaced (Atari)
Atari and Sad Cat Studios’ cyberpunk platformer Replaced is coming to Android on December 8, with pre-registration open. It is part of Google Play Games, so a single purchase covers mobile, tablets and PC, with save sync. The port is by The Knights of U.
Replaced launched on PC and Xbox Series X|S earlier this year and has passed 900,000 players across platforms.
Dome Keeper (Raw Fury)
Raw Fury and bippinbits’ roguelite survival miner Dome Keeper is out now on iOS and Android, after launching on PC back in 2022. Players must defend their dome from alien waves and dig for resources and relics between attacks.
Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall (Noodlecake)
Noodlecake has launched Brave At Night’s kingdom management game Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall on iOS and Android. Players must make moral choices to save a crumbling empire. It is part of Apple’s Indie Games Week.
Battle Spirits Teaching App (Bandai Namco)
Bandai Namco has released a free teaching app for its Battle Spirits card game on iOS and Android in Japan, teaching the game’s new Standard format through tutorial missions and free battles. The iOS version launched on October 7.
Pachislot Sengoku Collection 6 (Konami)
Konami has released Pachislot Sengoku Collection 6 (
パチスロ 戦国コレクション６
)
, a pachislot simulator, on iOS and Android in Japan, on October 13. The premium game simulates Konami’s Sengoku Collection 6 slot machine.
Azur Promilia (Manjuu)
Manjuu, the developer of Azur Lane, has announced an English open beta for fantasy RPG Azur Promilia in summer 2027, on a dedicated US server. The free-to-play game is in development for iOS, Android, PC and PS5.
The announcement follows the game passing 20m global pre-registrations. Players bond with creatures called Kibo, which help in combat and with farming, crafting and gathering.
Walk The Frog (Bright Gambit)
Cosy puzzle adventure Walk The Frog, from German indie developer Walk The Frog and publisher Bright Gambit, launched on Switch, iOS and Android on October 14 after its PC release. Players rearrange hand-drawn sticky notes to build a path home for Froggo, across 18 levels in three chapters with no timers.
